title: FileDrop
tagline: “Dropbox-like" app for Filecoin storage via Telegram bot interface
description:
Use case for the hackathon: 
End-user uploads files to Filecoin storage through Lighthouse provider via Telegram bot & WebApp interfaces. 

Problem:
- Telegram Cloud is centralized. Ex.: If you lose your account - you lose all your data
- It’s slow (upload/download)
- File size limit of 2Gb (which is pretty good for a messenger app, but still not sufficient)
- No guaranteed storage period. Your data may become unavailable at any time

Solution:
A decentralized Filecoin storage via Telegram interface that is truly yours.
Store and share ANY Files of ANY Size for ANY Time you need.
- Accessible from everywhere for ANY app or service
- Keep track of all your uploaded Filecoin files (local index)
- Private and Secure: A)we don’t have an access to you files; B)dApp runs completely on users device

Value Proposition:
Convenient (quick & simple) access to Filecoin's decentralized storage to ~1B Telegram users.

Next Steps (after hackathon):
- Integration in CTRL Wallet App
- Shared storage for Telegram Communities
- Built-in encryption (encrypt file before uploading it to Filecoin)
- Backup all data from Telegram account to Filecoin storage (chat history, photos and other media)
